test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 27 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Ram is brother of Shyam, Mohan is father of Ram, Sohan is the brother of Radhika, Radhika is the daughter of Shyam. Who is the paternal uncle of Sohan?
solution:
Preparing the family tree using the following symbols:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e4a3af6f8729b95aa5af83b613fc3f4f56394ee142d3bc17831c4c5058394c49.png] 

i) Ram is brother of Shyam, 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2af47865dc0283c59723acbbb50cd79f9d27c52298248dc319d0ee5d2a57119d.png] 

ii) Mohan is father of Ram, 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/887bbf490c05dba427b2c83102918dafcb12ad3cf1d3b9a3757c3f772f4fff82.png] 

iii) Radhika is the daughter of Shyam.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a8579e0fd73909818a2a2a29ac80c13a03c2aee75d1b81e32a280ab9e5e6514e.png] 

iv) Sohan is the brother of Radhika,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d3f59911c3fccc4138e12815100dd3986f1d8a94c45a60da19b9d53c285bbf2c.png] 

Here, Ram is the paternal uncle of Sohan. 

Hence, 'Ram' is the correct answer.
